links.outcome: LLM discharge educator performance across patient personas including health literacy and education level
links.effect: Aggregate scores concealed variation across ICD chapters and personas; difficult personas exposed coverage failures, comprehension gaps, and reduced source-answer agreement. No numbers in abstract.
links.quote: Across closed- and open-source LLMs, aggregate scores conceal clinically relevant variation across ICD chapters and patient personas; difficult personas expose coverage failures, comprehension gaps, and reduced source-answer agreement.

unlisted_practices: Persona-grounded multi-turn simulation with a virtual patient to evaluate LLM patient education
Monitor agent regulating simulated patient realism without altering the evaluated model
Scoring patient education on comprehension and topic coverage, not only text quality or accuracy

screen.reason: The paper introduces a simulation benchmark (DischargeBench) evaluating LLMs acting as discharge educators interacting with simulated patient personas, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
